title: Artemis II Astronauts Saw Rocks Hit the Moon in Tiny Flashes

scenes.text: Artemis II astronauts watched rocks hit the Moon, and saw them flash.
On April 6th, 2026, the crew passed the far side during a fifty-four-minute eclipse.
In the dark, they saw tiny flashes, each under a tenth of a second.
Scientists estimate each rock was a couple of inches wide, hitting at thousands of miles an hour.
Apollo astronauts saw flashes too, but these may be the faintest ever seen by eye.
Pebbles, thousands of miles an hour, seen from forty-six thousand miles away.

description:
During Artemis II's April 2026 flyby, the crew saw faint flashes of light on the Moon's dark side from small rocks striking its surface.
NASA estimates each rock was only a couple of inches wide, and the flashes may be the faintest ever seen with the naked eye.
Would you have spotted them?
